text.title: Nameplate text
text.description: Text to emboss on the nameplate. Alphanumeric and common punctuation.

corner_radius.title: Corner radius
corner_radius.description: Corner rounding radius in millimeters. 0 = sharp corners.

text_depth.title: Text depth
text_depth.description: Depth of engraved or raised text in millimeters.

text_raised.title: Raised text
text_raised.description: When true, text is raised above the plate surface. When false, text is engraved (cut into the plate).

margin.title: Margin
margin.description: Distance from text to plate edge in millimeters.

hole_mode.title: Mounting holes
hole_mode.description: Mounting hole pattern: none, two (left/right centered), or four (all corners).

hole_diameter.title: Hole diameter
hole_diameter.description: Diameter of mounting holes in millimeters.

font_name.title: Font
font_name.description: Font family (maps to DejaVu Sans/Serif/Mono on the runtime).
